headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance_le_count
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ) (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < r i) →
    (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 < c j) →
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U ≤ Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportCount r c U X

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance_positive
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ),
  2 ≤ m →
    2 ≤ n →
      0 <
          Fintype.card
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)) →
        0 < Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U
